pitch: A property baron wants a seat, a discreet operator, and absolutely no minutes of the meeting.
candidateBlurb: A fictional developer who regards planning committees as networking events. Publicly champions transparency; privately orders opaque envelopes by the pallet. Comfortable with dirty tactics, provided the consultant carries the blame.

objectives.label: Keep the patron composed (morale at least 25)

keepMessage: Vale thanks his investors, his family and the returning officer, in that order. Your invoice is paid from an account whose name you do not recognise.
sackMessage: Vale calls the campaign an unfortunate procurement decision. Security escorts the procurement decision out.

requires.label: Ruthlessness 75 — Vale wants an operator with a thoroughly dirty reputation
